protocol: Uninstrumented v19 timing matrix versus v18. A separate v19 cold compile per case times the real public module and the cached graph with tracing disabled, then records the SHA-256 of every launched code image on the same module and tests its same candidate objects. Median of 32 synchronized wall calls; independent 64-sample layer decomposition. Numeric staged control uses identical P800 pre-activation/product tensors before CPU FP64 activation or reduction. All failed attempts retained.
